preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(n) <= 50 and 0 <= int(k) <= 1000 for n, k in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[0].split()])
preconditions.description: Input must contain two integers n (number of tanks) and k (total allowed width increase), where 2 ≤ n ≤ 50 and 0 ≤ k ≤ 1000.
Input must contain exactly n + 1 lines: one for n and k, and n lines for the adjacency matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n adjacency matrix lines must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(cij) <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for cij in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each pipe width cij must be a non-negative integer ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(int(cij) == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i, cij in enumerate(line.split()) if i == int(line.split()[i]) - 1)
preconditions.description: Diagonal entries (cii) must be 0, indicating no self-loops.

postconditions.description: Output must be a non-negative integer representing the maximum flow from tank 1 to tank n after increasing pipe widths by at most k units in total.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(cij) + delta_cij <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i, cij in enumerate(line.split()) for delta_cij in [0] if int(cij) + delta_cij >= int(cij))
postconditions.description: The total increase in pipe widths (sum of all delta_cij) must not exceed k, and each pipe width must remain a non-negative integer ≤ 10^6.
The output must equal the maximum possible flow from tank 1 to tank n, where max_flow(stdin, k) is the maximum flow achievable by optimally increasing pipe widths by at most k units in total.
